name: Checkbox
summary: Native checkboxes, singly and in a fieldset, plus the tri-state parent — which needs a script because indeterminate is a property and no attribute exists for it.
demoNote: Tab through a group: every box is its own stop and the arrow keys do nothing, which is correct — any combination is allowed. Toggle one input in example 3 and the parent announces "mixed".

contract.useWhen: A native checkbox, kept focusable under whatever you draw over it.
keyboard: one stop per box — unlike radios, the arrows do nothing
failureModes: the drawn box replacing the input instead of sitting over it, so nothing is focusable
display:none or visibility:hidden on the real input, which removes keyboard access
indeterminate written as an attribute — it exists only as a JS property
related boxes with no fieldset and legend, so the question is never announced
api: AC.createCheckbox(root, options) -> { state, refresh, element, destroy }
